title: VINvoice registry key
description: One key of the VINvoice registry. The source is registry/keys/<name>.yaml (name = key without the root, e.g. de.hsn); generated/registry.json holds the same objects in its keys array.

key.description: Full key: the root and one or more dot-separated lower camel case segments (naming rule NR-01); a two-letter middle segment is a country scope (NR-02).

tier.description: Tier of the key; the allowed tiers are listed in registry/registry.yaml.

status.description: draft: part of the current draft. provisional: on probation or awaiting a check. stable: frozen from 1.0 on. deprecated: kept for readers, not to be written.

statutory.description: True if the key carries a feature that VAT law requires on the invoice. Statutory keys are always written with their label.

labelRequiredWhen.description: Optional. Full key of an indicator (token true) on the same line: while that indicator is true, this key MUST be written with its label, as a statutory key is (rule V-11). For a particular that national law requires only in a case, such as the engine capacity and power of a new means of transport (DE UStG §14a(4) with §1b(2)). It does not make the key statutory (naming rule NR-27).

labelRequiredVatCategory.description: Optional, only with labelRequiredWhen. VAT category code (BT-151, line level) that narrows the case: the labelled form is mandatory only on a line of this category, for example K (intra-Community supply) for the particulars of DE UStG §14a(4).

labelRequiredSellerCountry.description: Optional, only with labelRequiredWhen. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the seller's postal address (BT-40) that narrows the case: a national particular binds only the issuer in its state (naming rule NR-27), for example DE for DE UStG §14a(4).

repeatable.description: True if the key may appear more than once on a line.

unit.description: UN/ECE Recommendation 20 code of the unit fixed by the key, or null.

representationTerm.description: ISO/IEC 11179 / UN/CEFACT CCTS representation term of the value (Date, Code, Indicator, Number, Id, Measure ...).

labelDe.description: German label, used in BT-160 before the key in brackets.

labelEn.description: English label, used in BT-160 before the key in brackets.

grammar.description: Regular expression for the BT-161 value, anchored with ^ and $, in ECMAScript syntax with the u flag (\p{Lu} for upper-case letters; Python readers expand it, see checker/vehicle_check.py).

tokens.description: Allowed tokens when the value comes from a closed list; empty otherwise.

codeList.description: Code list or source of values, as prose. The tokens themselves are in tokens and in the registry's tokenLists.

conditionality.description: When the key is required, recommended or allowed.

carrier.description: How the key is written into the invoice (BG-32 row, and BT-128 or other terms where they apply).

anchors.description: Sources that fix the meaning: registration certificate codes, certificate of conformity items, law, national schemas. Separated by semicolons.
